audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and cooldown reference pointed at a non-existent ability, 'Repeating Dashes'. No real cooldown appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Her actual lane cooldowns are Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9s, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s, Cunning Sweep 14/13/12/11/10s and Public Execution 130/115/100s.
audit.corrected: Lacerate's 13s and Repudiation's 18s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], loading, tldr, whys[1] and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page invented 'Repeating Dashes' as her mobility and then repeatedly called Repudiation a 'W dash'. Repudiation is a 325-range shield-and-brace that grounds and slams — it has no dash. Her dash is Drakehound's Step (P), triggered by moving during any cast, plus Lacerate (E). Also missing: Repudiation's shield absorbing your burst, Public Execution's healing, and the fact that Nevermove roots on the return pass.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground'; P 'Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash'; Swain E 'It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits'.
audit.corrected: Real names substituted throughout; the shield, the grounding brace, the passive dash tell and the return-pass root now stated in whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0].text, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in itemisation but the reason was never stated in the trading text, even though Public Execution carries the heal flag.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds timing is what decides the extended trade against her ultimate.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now names Repudiation's shield and Public Execution's healing as the reason anti-heal comes first.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability — it was fabricated and used in roughly twenty strings across both layers. I replaced it wherever the surrounding text is matchup-specific. focus.text ('Ambessa Repeating Dashes') is 24 characters, under the applier's 25-character skip threshold, so it cannot be corrected by an edit — it needs a manual fix or a tools change; the same fabricated name also survives in breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.trading, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, ahead, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[12].t, report[13].t, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull-adjacent boilerplate. Those are shared boilerplate strings and I did not rewrite all of them in one pass; a second sweep on this matchup is worthwhile.
